general.title: OMIX DEG Analysis
general.instructions:
Choose the analysis mode that matches the matrix: raw integer counts, Harmony-corrected donor means, or SCTransform donor means. Raw counts use edgeR/limma-voom. The two declared continuous-expression modes use direct limma without count normalization or voom. Do not interchange these inputs.

For a combined pseudobulk result, attach the folder containing its matrix, Pseudobulk_Sample_Metadata.csv, and Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf; leave the file selectors blank. The adapter discovers the bundle and validates its matrix type against Analysis Mode. Advanced users can select the manifest explicitly. Ordinary tables and raw-count MOO input remain supported.

The default column names are GeneName, Sample, Group, and Batch. For paired or repeated measurements, set Donor / Patient Column. Do not use technical batch as a donor. Mode-aware Auto settings preserve the raw-count defaults and disable count-only processing for continuous-expression modes.

datasets.name: DEG input data (matrix + metadata)
datasets.description: Attach one raw-count table and metadata pair, one complete pseudobulk result bundle, or one compatible MOO. A pseudobulk bundle contains Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf, Pseudobulk_Sample_Metadata.csv, and exactly one mode-specific matrix. Leave file selectors blank for automatic bundle discovery. Raw-count tables must be integer-like; Harmony and SCT donor means must use their matching Analysis Mode.

categories.name: 📁 Input Data
categories.description: Provide a matrix plus metadata, a complete pseudobulk bundle, or one raw-count MOSuite MOO (.rds).

categories.name: 🧪 Experimental Design
categories.description: Define biological comparisons and any sample-level adjustment variables.

categories.name: ⚙️ Processing and Output
categories.description: Mode-aware Auto settings use raw-count processing only when Analysis Mode is raw_counts.

categories.name: 🔬 Advanced
categories.description: Use explicit files or processing choices only when automatic discovery and mode-aware defaults are unsuitable.

parameters.name: Input Type
parameters.description: Auto uses a table or pseudobulk bundle when one is discoverable; otherwise it accepts exactly one .rds as a MOO. MOO is valid only with raw_counts.

parameters.name: Analysis Mode
parameters.description: Must match the matrix semantics. raw_counts runs edgeR normalization plus limma-voom. harmony_mean_expression and sct_mean_expression run direct limma on declared donor-level log2 expression.

parameters.name: Matrix File (Optional)
parameters.description: Select a CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS matrix. Leave blank to discover the mode-specific matrix from one attached pseudobulk bundle or unambiguous table asset.

parameters.name: Sample Metadata File
parameters.description: Select a CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS sample-metadata table. Leave blank to discover Pseudobulk_Sample_Metadata.csv beside one manifest or another unambiguous metadata table.

parameters.name: MOO File (Optional; Raw Counts Only)
parameters.description: One compatible multiOmicDataSet .rds. Use only with Analysis Mode = raw_counts. The adapter extracts its raw count layer and embedded sample metadata.

parameters.name: Pseudobulk Manifest (Optional)
parameters.description: Advanced override for Pseudobulk_Manifest.dcf. Leave blank to discover exactly one attached manifest. The adapter validates matrix_type against Analysis Mode and discovers its paired matrix and metadata in the same folder.

parameters.name: Feature ID Column
parameters.description: Column in the matrix containing feature or gene identifiers. Default matches OMIX pseudobulk and demo inputs.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column
parameters.description: Metadata column whose values exactly match matrix sample columns.

parameters.name: Samples to Include (Optional)
parameters.description: Comma-separated sample IDs. Leave blank to use all metadata samples that occur in the matrix.

parameters.name: Biological Group Column(s)
parameters.description: One metadata column, or two comma-separated columns for a two-factor design. Default matches the demo data.

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.description: Comma-separated numerator-denominator comparisons, for example B-A or Treatment.Responder-Control.Responder.

parameters.name: Additional Fixed Covariates (Optional)
parameters.description: Comma-separated metadata columns to include as fixed effects. Do not repeat the donor column here. For SCT means, put an unhandled technical batch here rather than in Technical Batch Column(s).

parameters.name: Technical Batch Column(s) (Optional)
parameters.description: Auto uses Batch for raw_counts and no batch term for continuous-expression modes. Harmony means forbid a second batch correction. For SCT means, use Additional Fixed Covariates for an unhandled batch.

parameters.name: Donor / Patient Column (Optional)
parameters.description: Set for genuine repeated-measures designs. The model uses duplicateCorrelation and rejects unaggregated donor-by-group technical replicates.

parameters.name: Apply Design-Aware Low-Expression Filtering
parameters.description: Auto enables design-aware edgeR filtering for raw_counts and disables it for Harmony/SCT donor means.

parameters.name: Append Adjusted Expression Columns
parameters.description: Auto appends adjusted voom expression for raw_counts and returns continuous-expression inputs unchanged. This never changes DE statistics.

parameters.name: Remove Donor Effect from Downstream Expression
parameters.description: Auto removes donor effects from the raw-count downstream expression block when a donor column is set. Continuous inputs are returned unchanged.

parameters.name: Write Normalization Diagnostics
parameters.description: Auto writes log-CPM and voom diagnostics for raw_counts only. Continuous-expression modes do not have count-normalization diagnostics.

parameters.name: Normalization Method
parameters.description: Auto uses TMM for raw_counts and None for Harmony/SCT donor means. Other profiles are raw-count sensitivity options and should be chosen only after reviewing diagnostics.

parameters.name: Duplicate Feature-ID Handling
parameters.description: Auto uses sum for raw counts and mean for continuous log2 expression. Explicit sum, mean, and max remain available.
